eligibility_effect.note: PROPOSED_PENDING_SD_A (Scientific + Owner; NOT adopted): single Q01 disposition rule — see eligibility_effect.disposition_rule (the sole rule source). (1) exclusive terminal co-selected with affiliation: terminal wins (RARELY/NEVER -> AREA_OUTSIDE; NOT_SURE -> AREA_UNKNOWN); (2) sole terminal likewise; (3) any code not in `codes` -> REJECT -> answer_state INVALID, Q01_SCREEN SCREEN_INVALID (unknown_code_policy REJECT is the only unknown-code exit; it is NOT AREA_UNKNOWN); (4) empty -> AREA_UNKNOWN; (5) affiliations only -> ELIGIBLE. 'INVALID at Q01 screen' is the subtracted SCREEN_INVALID partition term of the Q_pre/Q_post formula, not a competing route.

disposition_rule.note: v0.6 encoded the same terminal-wins choice using adoption language while still leaving three competing clauses in the bytes; v0.6.1 keeps the choice (required for determinism) but deletes every competing clause and re-marks it as a proposal for SD-A.

rules.case: exclusive terminal (RARELY, NEVER, NOT_SURE) co-selected with any affiliation code
rules.disposition: terminal wins: RARELY/NEVER -> AREA_OUTSIDE; NOT_SURE -> AREA_UNKNOWN; never INVALID, never ELIGIBLE

rules.case: any selected code not in `codes` (unknown code)
rules.disposition: REJECT: item answer_state = INVALID; Q01_SCREEN = SCREEN_INVALID; unit leaves the funnel via the SCREEN_INVALID partition term; never AREA_UNKNOWN, never ELIGIBLE (unknown_code_policy REJECT is the single rule)

rules.case: affiliation codes only (any overlap, all in `codes`)

disposition_rule.totality: Every possible Q01 answer set maps to exactly one of {AREA_OUTSIDE, AREA_UNKNOWN, SCREEN_INVALID, ELIGIBLE}; every value of routing_model.route_inputs.Q01_SCREEN has exactly one declared exit (routing_model.screen_value_exits).
disposition_rule.single_rule_source: items[0]/eligibility_effect/disposition_rule is the ONLY source of the Q01 screen disposition. The general exclusive-conflict->INVALID clauses (denominator_invariants, single_select_and_multi_select_guards, E_EXCLUSIVE_CODE_CONFLICT) and the INVALID answer-state trigger list DO NOT apply to Q01. There is no competing disposition anywhere in this contract.

validation.coverage_limitation: Affiliation categories are proposed; the geographic predicate that turns them into eligibility is not approved (Task B / SD-02 formal).
validation.forbidden_inference: Respondent residence; residential totals; demand counts; treating NOT_SURE as eligible or ineligible

legacy_successor_map.rule: Each code declares whether it is comparable to a legacy CS-01 code. A code with no successor must not be pooled with any other code, and legacy and successor distributions must not be pooled without a declared comparability rule.

validation.ordinal_only_rationale: Only a Juster-type 0-10 scale carries a validated probability interpretation (Juster 1966; Brennan & Esslemont, Marketing Bulletin 1994/95, on accuracy for fast-moving consumer goods). non_substantive_reasons.OTHER: UNCODABLE_OTHER — the respondent gave an answer that falls outside the approved category set; it is a real answer event (counted in A) but it can never enter a category distribution's valid denominator (never in V).
